title: geranium proximum
intro: Geranium proximum, commonly known as a type of geranium plant, is a perennial herb that belongs to the family Geraniaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Geranium proximum include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve mood, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of the plant, which include geraniin, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects.
